headline: Onkar Kanwar Substantial Acquisition Disclosure in PTL Enterprises
sum: Onkar Kanwar submitted a disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations Reg. 31(4) for substantial acquisition of shares in PTL Enterprises Limited. The filing indicates a cross-threshold shareholding event triggering mandatory regulatory disclosure on the NSE.
detail: Onkar Kanwar submitted a formal disclosure to the NSE under SEBI's takeover regime. The filing invokes Regulation 31(4) of the 2011 Takeover Regulations, which mandates disclosure of substantial share acquisitions. The precise shareholding quantum, consideration, and any conditions precedent are not disclosed in the filing header; the full disclosure document would contain detailed schedules (shareholding pattern, sources of funds, timing). This is a regulatory filing compliance event, not necessarily an announcement of a hostile or agreed transaction.
